title: Coral and the Inheritance
author: Kestrel Ravensworth
blurb: Ada Hartwell, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
